texts.bt_a_expired: Liphelelwe yisikhathi. Ithikithi alizange lishintshwe ngesikhathi.
texts.bt_a_refer: Lokhu kuwina kuka-{amount} kungaphezu komkhawulo wesitolo. Kudlulisele ehhovisi elikhulu.
texts.bt_a_short_of_cash: Idrowa alinayo u-{amount}. Kudlulisele, noma ukhokhe uma ukheshi usengeziwe.
texts.bt_collect: I-opharetha ithumele ukheshi. Owinile uwuthatha lapha ngekhodi yakhe.
texts.bt_coming: I-LynkBet izoqala lapha uma i-opharetha enelayisensi isisayinile.
texts.bt_commission_note: Isilinganiso. I-opharetha ikhokha ikhomishini futhi isitatimende sayo yisona esinqumayo.
texts.bt_dispute_sent: Kuthunyelwe ku-opharetha. Ikhasimende lingalandela isinyathelo ngasinye.
texts.bt_keep: Ikhasimende ligcina ithikithi lokuqala lize likhokhwe.
texts.bt_locked_note: Kukhokhwa inani le-opharetha kuphela. Alikwazi ukushintshwa.
texts.bt_needs_net: Ukubheja kudinga uxhumano lwe-inthanethi. Akukho okugcinelwa kamuva.
texts.bt_offline_mode: Ayikho i-inthanethi. Ukubheja kwamukelwa njengezilipi ezilindile kuze kubuye uxhumano. Izinkokhelo ziyalinda.
texts.bt_queued_note: Ayikho i-inthanethi. Isilipi siya ku-opharetha uma uxhumano lubuya. Uma i-opharetha isenqaba, ikhasimende libuyiselwa yonke imali yalo.
texts.bt_safer_age: Abantu abaneminyaka engu-{age} noma ngaphezulu kuphela abangabheja. Cela umazisi uma ungaqiniseki.
texts.bt_safer_exclude: Ikhasimende elikhethe ukuyeka ukubheja alikwazi ukubheja.
texts.bt_safer_limits: Amakhasimende angasetha imikhawulo yawo futhi aphumule izinsuku ezingu-1, 7 noma 30 ku-opharetha.
texts.bt_scan_hint: Bamba ikhodi yethikithi ngaphansi kwesikena esingezansi kwesikrini.
texts.bt_second_needed: Izinkokhelo zika-{amount} noma ngaphezulu zidinga isisebenzi sesibili.
texts.bt_sf_note: Lokho noma ubani angakubona ekhasini lesitolo sakho, lapho umthetho uvumela khona kuphela. Awekho amathuba, okunikezwayo noma ukukhangisa.
texts.bt_slip_live: Ukubheja bukhoma akusebenzi nanini ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi.
texts.bt_slip_slip_cap: Le mali ebhejwayo ingaphezu komkhawulo we-opharetha ongaxhunyiwe.
texts.bt_slip_starts_soon: Lo mdlalo uqala ngokushesha kakhulu esilipini esingaxhunyiwe.
texts.bt_try: Ama-opharetha okuhlola, imidlalo eyisibonelo, imali yokuhlola kuphela. Khetha ithikithi eliyisibonelo ngezansi ukuze ulihlole, noma vala i-inthanethi ukuze wamukele isilipi esilindile.
